resources.string: Fingertip se dil ki dhadkan — bina kisi sensor, bina AI. Sirf camera aur flashlight.

1. Start dabao aur camera permission do
2. Index finger se back camera + flash ko poora cover karo
3. 30 second tak haath stable rakho
4. Bas — tumhara heart rate ready!
Finger se camera + flash cover karo
Signal weak hai — finger poora cover karo aur haath stable rakho
Abhi koi reading nahi. Pehla measurement karo!
Camera permission zaroori hai — bina camera pulse detect nahi ho sakta.
Yeh fitness ke liye hai, medical device nahi.
